summary: Recent selected papers emphasize charmonium cold-nuclear-matter baselines, small-x TMD evolution, vector-meson spin alignment, strangeness recombination, thermal photon rates in chirally imbalanced QGP, quantum-simulation frameworks for open heavy-ion dynamics, and bias-corrected ML estimators for lattice-QCD cumulants.
strongest_paper_summary: LHCb SMOG2's psi(2S)-to-J/psi pAr/pp double-ratio measurement and the JIMWLK small-x TMD approximation audit are the most immediately useful heavy-ion contributions; the lattice-QCD ML study is the strongest physics-AI paper because it directly tests bias propagation.

papers.title: First measurement of the ratio of psi(2S)-to-J/psi inclusive production in pAr and pp collisions at sqrt(sNN)=113 GeV with SMOG2
papers.short_authors: LHCb collaboration: R. Aaij, M. Abdelfatah, A.S.W. Abdelmotteleb, C. Abellan Beteta, F. Abudinen, et al.
papers.abstract: A measurement of the psi(2S)-to-J/psi production cross-section ratio is performed in proton-argon and proton-proton collisions in fixed-target mode at sqrt(sNN)=113 GeV. The pAr-over-pp double ratio is 0.90 +/- 0.04 +/- 0.02, indicating nuclear effects in the pAr system.

papers.title: Small-x TMD distributions: JIMWLK evolution and the Gaussian truncation
papers.abstract: The authors evolve small-x quark-gluon and gluon-gluon TMD distributions with JIMWLK dynamics and compare against Gaussian truncation of the Balitsky hierarchy, finding that the truncation fails for many evolved distributions.

papers.title: Medium effect on spin alignment of strange and charm vector mesons
papers.short_authors: Ruixiang Chen, Hiwa A. Ahmed, Yidian Chen, Mei Huang
papers.abstract: A four-flavor soft-wall holographic framework is used to compute spin-resolved spectral functions and rho00 trends for strange and charm vector mesons in finite-temperature, finite-density, rotating medium conditions.

papers.title: Production of the phi and Omega via recombination of jet parton showers in relativistic heavy ion collisions
papers.short_authors: Kyong Chol Han, Sungtae Cho, Su Houng Lee
papers.abstract: The paper combines coalescence and a hybrid shower-thermal recombination plus remnant string-fragmentation framework to describe phi and Omega production in sqrt(sNN)=5.02 TeV heavy-ion collisions.

papers.title: Quantum Simulation of Markovian and Non-Markovian Open Quantum Dynamics in Heavy-Ion Collisions
papers.abstract: The authors propose a quantum-computing framework for Markovian and non-Markovian open quantum systems, using an auxiliary pseudomode to carry memory and reproduce the target memory kernel.

papers.title: High energy thermal photons from chirally imbalanced QGP
papers.short_authors: Sourav Duari, Nilanjan Chaudhuri, Pradip Roy, Sourav Sarkar
papers.abstract: The paper computes hard thermal photon emission from a chirally asymmetric QGP and combines it with previous soft HTL results, finding an enhanced emission rate in the presence of chiral imbalance.

papers.title: Bias-Corrected Machine-Learning Estimation of Chiral Condensate Cumulants: A Retrospective Lattice QCD Case Study
papers.short_authors: Benjamin J. Choi, Hiroshi Ohno, Akio Tomiya
papers.abstract: The paper tests bias-corrected supervised ML estimates of inverse-Dirac-operator traces and derived chiral-condensate cumulants, showing agreement with full-data references under the adopted criteria and warning that uncorrected estimates can amplify downstream deviations.

cautions.title: ConCA: Concentration-Aware Channel Attention for Fine-Grained Visual Recognition
cautions.abstract: The abstract presents a general computer-vision channel-attention module evaluated on fine-grained visual-recognition benchmarks, without a detector, reconstruction, or physics-analysis validation task.
